acceptanceCriteria: Resolved as the finding's Fix describes, with a regression test for any code change, or closed by an owner decision that rejects the finding.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 expert panel review (main report or Beamfall/corvint-tasks addendum; confirmed by at least one verifier). Finding text: ### B6. CCF-V1-007's N-1 premise is false and the enum rule is untestable - Severity: medium. Core: yes. Votes: 1/1 confirmed. Reported by: wire-contract. - Location: `docs/specs/core-compatibility-freeze-v1.md:120,128` ("Because nothing changed since 0.7.0"); `internal/contextindex/taskcontext.go:199` (`instruction-routed` relation added since 0.7.0 inside frozen member `coverage.unexamined`). - Failure: tags v0.8.0 and v0.8.1 exist; 255 files under cmd/corvint and internal changed since v0.7.0; a frozen member gained an enum value with no rule saying whether that is breaking. Reviewers apply CCF-V1-006 by judgement. - Fix: set N-1 = 0.8.1, drop the premise, list each frozen enumeration with its value set and open/closed status, and add a release gate that builds the previous tag and replays all 12 Core verbs on pinned fixtures diffing key shapes and identifiers (the reviewer did this by hand in minutes). - Known ticket: none.
title: panel B6: CCF-V1-007's N-1 premise is false and the enum rule is untestable
